text:
deploy-bot: publish blocked — registry rejected push with 422: tag conflict for release/canary-2026-03-23. upstream CI also reports 2/5 e2e failures (payment flow timeout). Promotion paused.

nina: pinging registry team. 422 usually means a race where two pipelines pushed same tag. any concurrent promotes?

arjun: saw a transient rerun earlier that retried the push and may have left a partial manifest. registry team, can you confirm tombstone state?

ops-bot: registry incident created #REG-412 at 1749308700. Investigating possible manifest overwrite protection hit.

beth: payment e2e failures look like test flakiness (timeout waiting for stripe-mock). test infra team alerted.

arjun: options: 1) force push artifact with new immutable digest tag and update canary pointer, 2) pin to previous good digest and manual promote in change window, 3) rollback commit that caused flaky tests and re-run pipeline.

nina: prefer option 1 if registry will accept immutable digest push — avoids blocking change window. but we need to ensure canary validation passes.

beth: agree but tests failing mean validation won't pass. if we force push we might still block rollout. I'd rather pin to last-good digest (sha256:ff12aa) and keep canary at low traffic until we fix e2e flaky tests.

kevin: oncall here. registry says partial manifest was cleaned up, they can accept a new push to a unique tag. we can push to release/canary-2026-03-23-v2 and retry CI.

arjun: push command: `docker push registry.redwood.io/release/canary-2026-03-23-v2` then `deploy-bot update-pin --ref canary --tag canary-2026-03-23-v2`. we'll need to update release notes and run full canary smoke.

nina: timeline: if registry push succeeds and e2e fixes within 30m, we can resume auto-promote. otherwise pin to sha256:ff12aa and schedule manual promote in change window 15:00-17:00 PT.

beth: opening a follow-up ticket for flaky payment e2e and stripe-mock scaling tests. linking CI logs to ticket.

deploy-bot: action taken: promotion = HELD, attempted tags: release/canary-2026-03-23 (422). Suggested tag: release/canary-2026-03-23-v2.

kevin: i'll attempt the v2 push now and re-run smoke. will report back in thread.

arjun: thanks. if anything blocks, we'll fall back to pin and manual promote. keep release notes updated with the decision.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. logging decision path: attempt v2 push -> rerun CI -> if e2e green then resume -> else pin to sha256:ff12aa and manual promote in change window.
